name: sdd-marketplace
description: Distribution channel for the Spec-Driven Development framework — install with /plugin install sdd@sdd-marketplace.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development — opinionated workflow that mechanically refuses commits drifting from approved decisions. Four playbooks (feature, project, bug, refactor), plain-English specs, append-only audit trail, mutation-verified test suite, mechanical test-first hook (RED before GREEN), and sdd-migrate.sh for updatable installs.
